justification: Inspected byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/AbstractByteBuddyTask.java, especially lines 605-647. The nested TransformationLogger is a very small helper: one private Logger field, one constructor, and five overridden listener methods, all forwarding to logging calls only. It has a single cohesive responsibility (logging Plugin.Engine events) and shows no evidence of multiple responsibilities, large method count, or separable abstractions.
